name: Spain
sub: Street containers under Ley 7/2022: Ecoembes yellow and blue, Ecovidrio green, brown organic and grey rest, plus punto limpio and SIGRE at pharmacies.

banana.w: Peels go in the brown bin for compost; where no brown bin exists yet, use the grey one.

eggshell.w: Egg shells are organic waste for the brown bin.

coffee.w: Coffee grounds go in the brown bin; plastic or aluminium capsules do not.

bones.w: Meat and fish bones are accepted in the brown organic bin.

shampoo.w: Plastic bottles are packaging, so they go in the yellow container.

polybag.w: Plastic carrier bags are packaging and go in the yellow container.

chips.w: Crisp packets, even foil-lined ones, are packaging for the yellow container.

tube.w: Toothpaste tubes are packaging and go in the yellow container.

carton.w: In Spain drink cartons go in yellow, not blue, because they contain plastic and aluminium layers.

eggtray.w: Moulded cardboard egg boxes go in the blue paper container.

pizza.w: Ecoembes says grease stains are fine in blue; tear off parts caked in food for the grey bin.

box.w: Flatten cardboard boxes and put them in the blue container.

newspaper.w: Newspapers go in the blue paper container.

jar.w: Glass jars go in the green igloo; the metal lid goes in yellow.

wine.w: Glass bottles go in Ecovidrio's green igloo.

perfume.w: Glass perfume and cologne bottles are packaging, so they go in green without the cap.

tin.w: Food tins and cans are metal packaging for the yellow container.

window.w: Window glass melts differently from bottle glass; take it to a punto limpio.

drinkglass.w: Drinking glasses are not packaging and would spoil green-bin glass; wrap and put in grey.

mirror.w: Mirrors have a metal coating and are not packaging; take them to a punto limpio.

tissue.w: Many councils accept used paper napkins and tissues in brown; others ask for grey.

diaper.w: Diapers are not accepted in organic or packaging bins; they go in the grey container.

pad.w: Sanitary products go in the grey rest container.

battery.w: Batteries go to battery collection boxes in shops or to a punto limpio.

bulb.w: CFL bulbs contain mercury; return them to the shop or a punto limpio, never the green igloo.

meds.w: Take medicines and their boxes to the SIGRE point at any pharmacy.

paint.w: Paint is hazardous household waste for the punto limpio.

toy.w: The yellow bin takes packaging only; a plastic toy goes in grey, or big ones to a punto limpio.
